The strongest Dragon-type move is called
Draco Meteor.\c
Do you want me to teach the move to
your Pokémon?
I understand... Moves that are too strong\ncan be difficult to use.

It looks like your Pokémon can learn my move,
but there’s one condition that needs to be met.\c
That is...the Pokémon has to be completely
friendly toward you.\c
I can teach the move only after the Pokémon
becomes totally bonded with you.

None of the Pokémon you are with right now can
learn this move...\c
Come back when you obtain a Pokémon that can
learn this move!
Then please select the Pokémon that will learn\nthis move.
Oh, this Pokémon can’t learn this move.
Oh, this is an Egg.\nIt can’t learn this move or any move.
Oh, this Pokémon already knows Draco Meteor.

Draco Meteor is indeed the strongest
Dragon-type move.\c
However, using it harshly lowers the user’s
Sp. Atk stat.
Choose a move that will be replaced\nwith [VAR 0107(0000)].

One...[WAIT 20]two...[WAIT 20]and...[WAIT 20][WAIT 20]ta-da![VAR BE05(0003)][VAR BE05(0000)]\c\n[VAR 0102(0000)] forgot [VAR 0107(0001)]!\c\nAnd it learned [VAR 0107(0002)] instead![VAR BE05(0004)][VAR BE05(0001)]
